paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between layer number and the standard deviation of perplexity, with perplexity measured in logarithmic units. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 32, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Std (Perplexity) (log)” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.75, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. A single orange line with diamond-shaped markers represents the data; it begins at approximately (0, 1.73) and decreases rapidly to approximately (2, 0.32). Between x-values of 2 and 10, the line gradually declines from 0.32 to about 0.08. From x-value 10 to 32, the line fluctuates between approximately 0.04 and 0.12, ending at approximately (32, 0.07).
